title: BAF-core subunit loss converges on a 151 TH synaptic-output module, while ARID1B and SMARCA ATPases are buffered
exact_observed_result: Arid1a, Smarcb1, Smarcc2, and Smarce1 perturbations converged in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut on same-direction BAF-output genes including Ptpn3, Begain, Reep2, Prkcd, Kcnq2, Lrrc7, Nexn, and Clstn2, whereas Arid1b and the Smarca ATPases were weak or not concordant in the same comparison.
biological_interpretation: A mature thalamic neuron state depends on selected cBAF/core output subunits, but acute loss of every SWI/SNF paralog is not equivalent in this neuronal RNA readout.

source_findings.direction: Smarcb1 down; 149 genes down and 137 genes up at FDR<0.05 in the selective 151 response
source_findings.summary: Smarcb1 loss produced a broad, FDR-resolved transcriptional response almost exclusively in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.
source_findings.why_it_matters: A ubiquitous chromatin-remodeling subunit did not yield a uniform pan-neuronal phenotype; the main interpretable effect is a specific state in one TH/Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class.
source_findings.comparators: 155 MB Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|other Smarcb1 cell-type contrasts
source_findings.main_caveats: The Smarcb1 transcript itself was only FDR 0.0936 in 151 and protein depletion was not measured.

source_findings.direction: Arid1a down with mixed downstream response, 7 up and 15 down among FDR genes
source_findings.summary: A multiple-testing-corrected Arid1a loss signature was concentrated in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.
source_findings.why_it_matters: This identifies the thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic group as the main interpretable Arid1a-responsive state in the dataset instead of treating Arid1a loss as pan-neuronal.
source_findings.main_caveats: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut also had the largest Arid1a perturbed-cell count, so selectivity and statistical power are partly confounded.

source_findings.summary: Arid1a converged with Smarcc2, Smarcb1, and Smarce1 perturbations in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.
source_findings.why_it_matters: The nearest-neighbor pattern links the Arid1a phenotype to canonical BAF core assembly rather than to an arbitrary chromatin-stress response.
source_findings.main_caveats: Full-rank correlations are modest in absolute value, although Smarcc2/Smarcb1/Smarce1 were ranked first to third among all perturbations and the corrected Arid1a genes were directionally concordant with Smarcc2 and Smarcb1.

source_findings.summary: Smarcc2 perturbation produced a broad, FDR-significant transcriptional program almost exclusively in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.
source_findings.why_it_matters: A nuclear BAF core perturbation was not interpreted as a uniformly pan-neuronal stressor; the dataset localizes the high-confidence response to one excitatory thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c class despite directional target-transcript suppression in all tested classes.
source_findings.comparators: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|145 MH-LH TH Glut|155 MB Glut
source_findings.main_caveats: The assay measures RNA, not chromatin occupancy or protein loss; several non-151 groups had lower perturbation cell counts.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Smarcb1 guide results were present in 23 cell types; Smarcb1 mRNA logFC was negative in 22/23, median logFC -0.331, range -0.663 to +0.038; 9/23 tests had nominal p<0.05, 6/23 had p<0.01, and only 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut reached p_adj<0.10 for the Smarcb1 transcript itself.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Direct quantification of on-target transcript depletion where Smarcb1 was measured.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 246 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; Smarcb1 logFC -0.331, p=0.00205, p_adj=0.0936. The DE signature contained 286 genes at FDR<0.05: Ptpn3 logFC -0.952 p_adj 1.30e-31, Reep2 -0.610 p_adj 5.54e-26, Tiam1 -0.722 p_adj 2.88e-18, C1qtnf4 -0.543 p_adj 1.19e-17, Rsrp1 -0.303 p_adj 5.28e-16, Myt1 +0.543 p_adj 1.84e-15, Prkcd -0.537 p_adj 2.45e-12, Nexn +0.652 p_adj 4.94e-09, Stxbp2 -0.782 p_adj 1.09e-08.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The dominant Smarcb1 loss-of-function response occurred in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: At FDR<0.05, the 23 Smarcb1 cell-type contrasts contained 286 significant genes in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 3 in 155 MB Glut, 1 in 145 MH-LH TH Glut, and 0 in each of the remaining 20 cell types. At FDR<0.10 the counts were 391 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 6 in 155 MB Glut, 2 in 001 L5-6 IT Glut, 1 in 145 MH-LH TH Glut, and 0 in the remaining 19 cell types.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Cell-type distribution of downstream Smarcb1 differential-expression burden.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Arid1a transcript score was negative in 23/23 cell groups; 6 groups had score < -3; 4 had nominal p < 0.001. Strongest corrected cell group was 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut: logFC -0.462, score -4.927, p 8.34e-7, FDR 0.0030.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Measured target-transcript engagement for Arid1a across all assayed mouse brain cell groups.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 316 Arid1a cells versus 23679 controls; 17259 genes tested; 22 genes at FDR < 0.05, including Arid1a; 7 positive and 15 negative scores among those 22; 34 genes at FDR < 0.1.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Only the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut contrast produced a multi-gene FDR-corrected Arid1a perturbation signature.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Top positive FDR genes included Clstn2 score 6.226 logFC 0.385 FDR 4.82e-6, Ndrg4 score 4.779 logFC 0.109 FDR 0.00463, Slc25a23 score 4.642 logFC 0.240 FDR 0.00597, and Ppp2r5d score 4.530 logFC 0.210 FDR 0.00843. Top negative genes included Begain score -6.202 logFC -0.455 FDR 4.82e-6, Kcnq2 score -5.565 logFC -0.219 FDR 0.000151, Ptpn3 score -4.918 logFC -0.187 FDR 0.00302, Lrrc7 score -4.766 logFC -0.128 FDR 0.00463, Rasa4 score -4.704 logFC -0.412 FDR 0.00550, and Lef1 score -4.644 logFC -0.174 FDR 0.00597.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Highest-magnitude corrected genes in the Arid1a 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut signature.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Across 17259 genes and 2045 non-Arid1a perturbations, Wilcoxon-score correlations to Arid1a ranked Smarcc2 first with r=0.2745, Smarcb1 second with r=0.2383, Smarce1 third with r=0.1992, Arid1b fifth with r=0.1002, Smarca4 tenth with r=0.0675, Arid2 1774th with r=-0.0120, and Smarca2 fourth from the bottom with r=-0.0609.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Genome-wide perturbation-neighbor analysis in the cell type with the robust Arid1a response.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Among the 21 non-Arid1a FDR < 0.05 genes from the Arid1a signature, Smarcc2 changed all 21 in the same direction and 13 were also FDR < 0.05 under Smarcc2; Smarcb1 changed all 21 in the same direction and 12 were also FDR < 0.05 under Smarcb1; Smarce1 changed 19/21 in the same direction.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Direct same-direction overlap between the Arid1a corrected genes and core cBAF-related perturbation signatures in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 162 Smarcc2-perturbed cells versus 23,679 non-targeting controls; Smarcc2 logFC -0.472, Wilcoxon score -7.971, nominal p 1.58e-15, FDR 6.80e-12; 185 genes passed FDR<0.05, 114 down and 71 up.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The only Smarcc2 contrast with a broad FDR-significant transcriptional response was in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Smarcc2 transcript rows were measured in 22 cell types; logFC was negative in 22/22, nominal p<0.05 in 18/22, and FDR<0.05 in 4/22. The FDR-significant target rows were 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA: 60 cells, logFC -0.668, FDR 1.86e-2; 145 MH-LH TH Glut: 75 cells, logFC -0.453, FDR 6.18e-3; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut: 162 cells, logFC -0.472, FDR 6.80e-12; 155 MB Glut: 140 cells, logFC -0.473, FDR 1.56e-3.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Target-transcript suppression was directionally consistent across all tested cell types but passed transcript-wide FDR in only four.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Of 22 Smarcc2-tested cell types, 18 had zero FDR<0.05 genes. In the remaining three non-151 cell types, Smarcc2 itself was the only FDR<0.05 gene; the best non-target FDR values were 0.189 in 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 0.306 in 145 MH-LH TH Glut, and 0.418 in 155 MB Glut.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Most contexts were transcriptionally buffered after Smarcc2 targeting, including three with FDR-significant target-transcript depletion.

caveats: Smarcb1 mRNA depletion in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut reached p_adj 0.0936 rather than the 5% FDR threshold.
The data measure acute RNA changes after partial guide perturbation and not BAF complex occupancy.
